features.name: Original Currency Code on GL Entry
features.description: The ability to store and view the original currency code on GL entry records. This has been a top request for over 5 years with more than 500 votes.

features.name: Control Posting of Currencies to GL
features.description: Ability to control which currencies are allowed to be posted to a specific GL account, with options for single currency, multiple currencies, or any currency.
caveats: Applies primarily to monetary assets, not typically to bank accounts, customer accounts, or vendor accounts

features.name: GL Account Revaluation
features.description: A batch job that automatically creates adjustment entries to revalue balances in GL accounts based on currency exchange rate changes. Adjustments are made per balance per currency.
caveats: Adjustments are per currency per balance, not per transaction
Different from standard currency exchange rate adjustments which work per customer/vendor
Should not be used for bank accounts, customer accounts, or vendor accounts as those have their own adjustment mechanisms

features.name: Enable Use of GL Currency Revaluation
features.description: Feature management setting that enables the GL currency revaluation functionality on GL accounts.

features.name: Multiple Currencies per GL Account
features.description: Support for posting multiple different currencies to the same GL account. Users can configure allowed currencies through a related table Source currencies and specify blank, single currency, or multiple currencies.
caveats: For demo purposes only - recommendation is to use single currency per account
Must be configured per GL account

features.name: Revaluation Account Configuration
features.description: Ability to specify which GL account receives the revaluation adjustment entries, with options for unrealized or realized gains and losses accounts configured on the currency setup.

features.name: Enhanced Currency Exchange Rate Batch Job
features.description: Batch job available in Currencies area that handles currency adjustments for customers, vendors, employees, and bank accounts. Can now adjust per entry instead of just per customer/vendor.
caveats: This is a separate batch job from GL revaluation
Works per customer/vendor/employee/bank account, not per GL balance
